question: Why can parents not save Class register (Network error) in UntisX (endpoint /class-book)?
answer: Check role parents. Module Class register may require higher permissions. Error Network error: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /class-book and the database connection. Feature Offline must be enabled.
